Varren Herald

Bring customers back with something true to say.

Varren Herald finds people who stopped partway, waits for a real reason to return, checks permission, uses approved wording and measures what came back against a group left alone.

Who it is for

Service businesses and platform teams that want to bring customers back for a useful, timely reason.

Agree what success looks like

Make the improvement visible.

Real reasons. Approved words. Proven return.

Re-engagement
without guesswork.

Herald measures the organisational goal and movement past the stalled step. It records every send, every refusal and every deliberate silence.

Find the stalled step

See where a person stopped in the purchase, application, enrolment or service journey.

Wait for something true

Contact begins only when a real event gives the person a relevant reason to return.

Check every permission

Lawful basis, consent, approved wording, withdrawal and contact limits are enforced before sending.

Prove the return

An eligible group is left alone so the organisation can compare what happened with and without contact.

Before any campaign

Know who you may
reach and why.

Herald first shows how many stalled people can lawfully be contacted and exactly why the rest cannot. Approved wording is sealed so the customer sees precisely what compliance and brand teams authorised.

Herald reads through an agreed guarded path and never alters the client's customer data.

Frequently asked

What is Varren Herald?

Varren Herald finds people who stopped partway, waits for a real reason to return, checks permission, uses approved wording and measures what came back against a group left alone.

Who is Varren Herald for?

Service businesses and platform teams that want to bring customers back for a useful, timely reason.

What problem does Varren Herald solve?

People start an application, purchase, enrolment or service journey and stop, while the organisation cannot tell who may be contacted or what would genuinely matter.

How does Varren Herald work?

Herald finds where they stopped, identifies a true occasion, checks lawful contact rules, locks approved wording and holds back a comparison group.

What changes once Varren Herald is running?

The organisation sees who was reachable, what was sent or refused, why, and how many reached the goal compared with people left alone.

How is success measured?

Goal reached against held-back group; movement past the stalled step; lawful reachability; refusals; withdrawals.

Can Varren Herald be deployed for a single organisation?

Yes. AlphaIT licenses, deploys, configures and integrates the system for each organisation, and engineers the missing connection or capability where the ready system does not fully fit. Scope, integrations, data permissions, acceptance checks, support and commercial terms are agreed per deployment.

Which countries can Varren Herald be deployed in?

AlphaIT Engineering works with organisations in Kenya, Nigeria, the United Arab Emirates and the wider Middle East. Deployment is subject to applicable law, the data permissions available and the authority of each participating organisation.
